title: Aa Kar Baba Menu Pyaar, Sakina Rul Gaee Ay
body:
Menu Seenay Laa Ik Waar, Sakina Rul Gaee Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadoun Ro Ro Bhardi Baba, Teri Yaad De Vich Mein Ho Kay
Teri Dhi Majboor Nu Zalim, Naa Tera Lain Ton Ro Kay,
Mera Jeena Hai Dushwaar, Sakina Rul Gaee Ay,
<<DIVIDER>>
Beemar Musafir Veeran, Teri Jaandi Haan Lachari,
Na Phul Na Qafan Na Paani, Nahi Shikva Veer Muhari,
Kar Qabar Meri Tayyar, Sakina Rul Gaee Ay,
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Veer Beemar De Bajoun, Hun Kaun Reya Ay Mera,
Ghazi Te Akbar Koyi Nayee, Jera Hath Ro Kay Aa Tera,
Beshak Tu Tamachay Maar, Sakina Rul Gaee Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Bari Mushkil Nal Bachayi, Shabbir Di Dhi Mein Pyaari,
Akhay Zainab Teri Ummat, Oh Vich Qaidaan De Maari,
Tak Nabiyaan De Sardar, Sakina Rul Gaee Ay,
